description: Per-output-channel-scaled fp8 storage of the DENOISER's block Linears: the weight becomes F8_E4M3 at its own shape and grows an F32 [out] `weight_scale` DEQUANT multiplier; every other tensor, and every other component, is untouched at BF16. THE PREDICATE IS TRANSCRIBED FROM THE PRODUCER, not from a description of it: python-gen-worker `src/gen_worker/convert/writer.py:544` `w8a8_cast_eligible` — a rank-2 float `.weight`, both dims 16-aligned (torch._scaled_mm's `_DIM_ALIGN`), under a repeated-block path segment (`\.\d+\.`), whose module path misses every skip pattern. The skip list is split by how the producer ANCHORS it: `embed`/`norm`/... match anywhere, while `^proj_in$`, `^proj_out$` and `^proj$` match only a module path that IS that word — which is why SDXL's `down_blocks.{i}.attentions.{i}.proj_in` DOES convert. The base dtype is BF16 and that is a CONVENTION FACT, not an accident: cozy fp8 artifacts are requantized from the bf16 source, so an fp8 tree whose passthrough tensors are F16 is a different packaging and must not wear this stamp. `input_scale` is deliberately absent: activation scales are dynamic at serve time, so the producer emits none, and a tree carrying them is a different, statically calibrated layout.
name: cozy.fp8-rowwise
